values.note: 2026: riverfront water + electric 30A $46, full hookup 30/50A $52, 50A pull-through $56. Rates cover two adults and two children; extra adult $10, extra child $5 a night; six people to a site.

fees.source: https://www.rivertrailcrossing.com/rates.html ('Pull Through Full Hook Up Sites (Water/Electric/Sewer) 50 AMP $56.00/Night; Full Hook Up (Water/Electric/Sewer) 30/50 AMP $52.00/Night; Riverfront Water & Electric 30 AMP $46.00/Night'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: 31 full-hookup sites (two pull-through) and 9 riverfront water + electric sites, plus 4 riverfront tent sites.

sites.source: https://www.rivertrailcrossing.com/assets/campground_map1.jpg (sites 3-31 and PT1, PT2 marked FH; 32-35 and 40-44 W/E; 36-39 Tent), read 2026-10-31

facilities.source: https://www.rivertrailcrossing.com/ ('Our restrooms, with hot showers and flush toilets ... our camp store is well stocked') + campground map ('Swimming Pond'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Credit card holds the reservation, charged on arrival. A week's notice to cancel, with a $5 fee. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.rivertrailcrossing.com/rates.html ('A credit card is required to hold a reservation...'), read 2026-10-31; no online booking on the site

note: On the Clear Fork River near Mohican SP; only the water + electric and tent sites are on the river, the full-hookup sites sit back from it. Adjacent B&O bike trail. --Claude
summary: Fees $46-56 confirmed. Added 50-amp, 40 RV sites (was 31: the 31 are the full-hookup count), showers/flush/store, season Apr 1-Oct 18, phone booking. Note corrected: full-hookup sites are not on the river.
flags: Gate facts: posted $46 riverfront W/E (the cheapest RV site, under $50), $52 full hookup, $56 pull-through. Good Sam directory says gs false. No gateway within 40 km (Columbus 85 km). Presence: own site with posted rates, phone reservations. Google Maps 4.7/141.

Long-stay: seasonal is sold ('$1,800.00 per Year plus metered electric') but no count of seasonals is published; nightly rates are posted (test 2 passes) and every one of the 44 mapped sites has a nightly class (test 4 passes on the published facts). Imagery shows a row of parked rigs in the full-hookup block.

Waterfront: stored riverfront stands on the operator's own map, which draws 13 sites (9 W/E, 4 tent) in a row along the Clear Fork, and its 'Riverfront Water & Electric' class. Canopy hides the bank on imagery. Only those 9 RV sites qualify; the $52 and $56 sites do not. Pin is at the SR 97 entrance, about 200 m from the sites: within tolerance.
